description: We are Team outer Wilds , rookies , and we are doomed .
summary:
*Project Name - Astronaut 

Astronaut is an all in one crew health monitoring software we created , which haws life-support , emergency situation handling protocols also guided breath exerciser ,

All these handles varieties of Health conditions and environmental status to prevent them getting any injuries or health crisis  which is as required by the challenge statement.

This software prototype neatly handles any emergency situations and guide the astronauts to be healthy and fit for the sake of mission. Final Goal is to have a safe and successful mission.
details:
*Astronaut* is a Health Monitoring Software prototype for Astronauts in a Space Craft on a Space Mission . It reads their Body Vitals and Surrounding Environment , which Helps in Treating a member and Making them aware of incoming cases.

The software mainly consists of 4 sections :

- Body & Vitals

- Spacewalk & Space Suit

- Emergency Situations

- Rest and Breathe

- Body and vitals has the health status report and electrocardiogram of the member.

- Spacewalk and Space Suit has the Orbital and Grid view of Space craft around the space body and the status of spacesuit like Oxygen level and current pressure of the suit .

- Emergency situations has various scenarios from which astronauts can be guided to do in emergency cases such as *air leak , *solar storm report , *High Blood Pressure.

- Rest and breathe has quick exercise of breathing for astronauts to control their anxiety and have refreshment .

This Software mainly focuses on the all round scenarios of problems that can occur during a space voyage .

- Tech Stack of Project :

React & Tailwind

Node / Next


- Tools :

Antigravity

VS code

Netlify

Creativity -

We have Implemented the idea of Oxygen Depletion of Space suit , Vitals , and Electrocardiogram by taking the references of following games :

'Outer Wilds' & 'Subnautica' , which are respectively space and ocean exploring games.

Our Team considered the software has to be Less Complex , Less Graphs and Less Compact in order to make the astronauts easier to use it .

All the data which are represented are Pseudo in order to explain how the official Software is gonna read and implement it.
